source_ref: Alinx AXVU13F User Manual REV1.0 (Chinese), sec 2-6 FMC+ pin tables pp.18-45; slots FMCP0=FMC1+ (J9), FMCP1=FMC2+ (J8), FMCP2=FMC3+ (J7), FMCP3=FMC4+ (J23). FMC1+ table erratum: FMC3+ bank-74 rows are interleaved into the LA17-LA25 region (dropped here; the bank-66 rows kept) and the FMC1+ LA25_P-LA33 rows are missing from the manual entirely, so those signals are absent here although the board routes 34 LA pairs. Vendor GBT0_0/GBT0_1 nets (MGTREFCLK0 inputs of the slot quads) read as connector GBTCLK0/GBTCLK1; GBT1_x nets are MGTREFCLK1 inputs fed by the on-board clock generator, excluded. Not schematic-verified (no schematic cached).
